extracted.name: Air fryer hunter's chicken
extracted.description: Use your air fryer to make classic hunter's chicken for dinner, with barbecue sauce, bacon and cheese. Serve with seasonal veg and potato wedges
ingredient_lines: 2 small skinless chicken breasts or 1 large cut in half lengthways
seasonal veg, potato wedges and ketchup, to serve
instruction_lines: Heat the air fryer to 190C. Wrap the chicken breasts in the bacon rashers widthways. Or, if the chicken breasts are very thick, cook in the air fryer for 10 mins first, then cook the bacon-wrapped chicken for 15 mins.

Brush with barbecue sauce all over and scatter over the cheese (you may not need all of it). Cook in the air fryer for another 10 mins until the chicken is cooked through. Serve with seasonal veg, potato wedges and ketchup on the side, if you like.
